question: Please tell me the percentage of participants not using quinapril and related medications(Quinapril RxCUI: 35208).
sql:
WITH quinapril_drugs AS (
  SELECT drug_concept_id 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_strength` 
  WHERE ingredient_concept_id = 1331235
),
persons_using AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT de.person_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` de
  JOIN quinapril_drugs qd ON de.drug_concept_id = qd.drug_concept_id
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`) - COUNT(DISTINCT pu.person_id),
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`)
  ) * 100 as percentage_not_using_quinapril
FROM persons_using pu
